notes: Served by GET /api/questionnaire (Contract.md 2.3). File-only fields not sent to web: slot, trait, skill_id, source_ids, options_source, max_choices (the api resolves options_source into options and enforces max_choices; adding max_choices to the Question type needs a Contract change). Scale answers are 1-5. A soft-skill answer of 4 or 5 adds that skill_id (from data/skills.json) to the profile as self-reported. Work-style items are self-reported preferences, not a personality diagnosis (PRD FR-7, FR-17). Question wording is the team's own; no item is copied from a source. All dimensions come from one source family: O*NET OnLine (USDOL/ETA, CC BY 4.0).
